title: QuantumTec
description: Website and customer portal for an SMS, email and Viber messaging service with a wide set of tools for business-to-customer communication.
infotext: Designed in Sketch, built on Next.js, content managed in Directus.
company: QuantumTec is a multi-channel service that helps businesses stay in touch with their customers. 24/7 support, coverage of more than 200 countries and over 800 carriers, plus handy tools for cleaning up contact lists before sending, make it a reliable platform for marketing campaigns.
problem: The task was to build a website from scratch that clearly presented all of the company's services, made information easy to reach and met the design standards of modern European companies. It also needed a convenient customer portal and a brand logo.
mockups_description: The design was developed with close attention to detail to create an intuitive interface and a visual identity that fits the QuantumTec brand. The website and customer portal layouts were designed with usability in mind.
result: The finished product is a light, well-structured and clear website that presents the company's services concisely and gives easy access to the messaging documentation. The new logo strengthens the brand and makes it more recognisable.
meta_title: Case study: website, customer portal and logo for QuantumTec
meta_description: Website and customer portal for QuantumTec, an SMS, email and Viber messaging service with powerful tools for business-to-customer communication.
